name: Alaska
agency: Alaska Department of Natural Resources, Office of Boating Safety

rule.textEn: Alaska has no mandatory boater education. An optional Alaska Boater Education card exists and is useful when boating in states that require one.
rule.textEs: Alaska no exige educación náutica. Existe una tarjeta opcional de educación náutica de Alaska, útil para navegar en estados que sí la exigen.

card.feeNote: The state also offers a free course, Alaska Water Wise.

sources.quote: Alaska is one of the few states that do not require boating education.
Our free Alaska Water Wise course was designed by us for Alaskan boaters.
